title: The seven measures as distances between landmarks, with no outline
caption: An AP and a lateral lumbar-shaped body with numbered landmarks: the four corners the body detector finds today, and the pedicles' medial borders and the spinolaminar point no head finds yet. Every measure is a distance between landmarks, so none needs a mask.
